description: Zeca, a cream-white duck wearing a little straw hat with green band, broad ochre bill, orange webbed feet, round belly, two folded wings, cheeky happy eyes. Hat stays the same size and orientation relative to his head.
prompt:
ORIGINAL cute PIXEL ART farm character, Zeca, a cream-white duck wearing a little straw hat with green band, broad ochre bill, orange webbed feet, round belly, two folded wings, cheeky happy eyes. Hat stays the same size and orientation relative to his head.
Style only from the attached dog atlas: warm palette, clean dark pixel contour, chunky small-pixel details, round cute silhouette. Keep this character's OWN species anatomy and unique accessories.
EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS by EIGHT COLUMNS, 64 whole characters, equal cells and broad transparent gutters. Every character fits in the middle 60% of its cell. True transparent background, no ground or shadows, no text. ALL ears, tails and feet fully inside their cell.
EIGHT distinct viewing directions, one row each: 1 SOUTH/front; 2 SOUTHWEST/front-left diagonal with head toward BOTTOM-LEFT and rump TOP-RIGHT; 3 WEST/left profile; 4 NORTHWEST/rear-left diagonal with head toward TOP-LEFT and rump BOTTOM-RIGHT, one side flank visible (NOT straight back); 5 NORTH/straight back; 6 NORTHEAST/rear-right diagonal with head TOP-RIGHT and rump BOTTOM-LEFT, a visible side flank (NOT side profile); 7 EAST/right profile; 8 SOUTHEAST/front-right diagonal head BOTTOM-RIGHT and rump TOP-LEFT.
Fixed slightly elevated orthographic camera, same body size, palette, markings and limb count across all64. Every row is a seamless eight-phase cycle: CONTACT A, DOWN A, PASSING A, UP A, opposite CONTACT B, DOWN B, PASSING B, UP B. Columns 1 and 5 must exchange left/right leg positions. Supporting foot sweeps backward while the lifted foot bends and returns forward. Fixed torso center, grounded baseline, stable head. All physical limbs accounted for, no morphing, limping, dragging or sliding, no repeated endpoint.
CRITICAL: Within a row the torso NEVER turns! Every column preserves the exact row's viewing angle. Head, torso and camera are locked; animate the legs and subtle secondary motion. Row5 is perfectly STRAIGHT BACK throughout all eight columns: two symmetrical ears/wings, nose and face hidden in every frame. Row1 perfectly STRAIGHT FRONT, same face throughout. Preserve all body proportions.
SPECIES MOTION: TWO-foot bird cycle, alternate left/right support evenly, clear toes/webbing, no third foot, wings remain wings. 1 left contact, 2 support,3 passing,4 reach,5 right contact,6 support,7 passing,8 reach. Whole character with generous margin, genuine transparent background, no text or gridlines.
